name: Casing drilling and expandable tubulars
applications: keeping hole size in deep wells
principle: Expandable tubulars are run and then enlarged by pulling or pushing an expansion tool through them, cutting the diameter lost with each casing string and aiming at a monobore well. The Wikipedia page read does not cover casing drilling (drilling with the casing itself).

source.note: Wikipedia, Expandable tubular technology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
Wikipedia, Expandable tubular technology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
